name: Jack
description: Jack is a graduate student and Ethereum Protocol Fellowship (EPF7) participant focused on Ethereum protocol development. His fellowship project explores the foundations for EIP-7807 SSZ execution blocks in Erigon, including execution-data mapping, progressive SSZ Merkleization, and block-root computation. He has contributed to Ethereum's execution-specs repository and participated in the LXDAO and ETHPanda communities. His interests include execution-layer infrastructure, verifiable data access, and open-source collaboration.
